# 2.Visualising Time-series Data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer <- ts_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::



## 2.1 Visualising single time-series: ggplot2 methods



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Malaysia") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
             y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Inclass_Ex7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



## 2.2 Plotting multiple time-series data with ggplot2 methods



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = ts_longer, 
       aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
           y = Arrivals,
           color = Country))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"))
```

# 3. Visual Analysis of Time-series Data

# 6. Visual Forecasting

## 6.1 Time Series Data Sampling



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_ts <- tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>% 
  mutate(Type = if_else(
    `Month-Year` >= "2019-01-01", 
    "Hold-out", "Training"))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_train <- vietnam_ts %>%
  filter(`Month-Year` < "2019-01-01")
```
:::




## 6.2 Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Time Series Data



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_train %>%
  model(stl = STL(Arrivals)) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](Inclass_Ex7_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-25-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



## 6.3 Fitting forecasting models

### 6.3.1 Fitting Exponential Smoothing State Space (ETS) Models: fable methods



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ETS(y ~ error(c("A", "M")) 
    + trend(c("N", "A", "Ad")) 
    + season(c("N", "A", "M")))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
<ETS model definition>
```


:::
:::



### 6.3.2 Fitting a simple exponential smoothing (SES)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fit_ses <- vietnam_train %>%
  model(ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") 
            + trend("N") 
            + season("N")))
fit_ses
```

## 6.4 Fitting ETS Methods with Season: Holt-Winters



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
Vietnam_WH <- vietnam_train %>%
  model(
    Additive = ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") 
                   + trend("A") 
                   + season("A")),
    Multiplicative = ETS(Arrivals ~ error("M") 
                         + trend("A") 
                         + season("M"))
    )

Vietnam_WH %>% report()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


## 6.5 Fitting multiple ETS Models



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fit_ETS <- vietnam_train %>%
  model(`SES` = ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") + 
                      trend("N") + 
                      season("N")),
        `Holt`= ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") +
                      trend("A") +
                      season("N")),
        `damped Holt` = 
          ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") +
                trend("Ad") + 
                season("N")),
        `WH_A` = ETS(
          Arrivals ~ error("A") + 
            trend("A") + 
            season("A")),
        `WH_M` = ETS(Arrivals ~ error("M") 
                         + trend("A") 
                         + season("M"))
  )
```
:::

## 7.7 Forecast Multiple Time Series

```{.r .cell-code}

  filter(Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "Malaysia" |

         Country == "Thailand" |
         Country == "Philippines")
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ASEAN_train <- ASEAN %>%
  mutate(Type = if_else(
```
